operations.title: Nima directs Grothendieck to the paired Mackey normalization gate
operations.body:
Please take the paired mixed-variance deck system as your next directed lane.

Frozen data:
- For q:G->H, coefficients are contravariant q^*:Fun(H)->Fun(G).
- Betti sheet orbits are covariant q_*:Q[G]->Q[H].
- Evaluation satisfies <q^*c,Gamma>_G=<c,q_*Gamma>_H.
- The dual coefficient transfer q_! and pullback satisfy composition, Frobenius reciprocity, and Beck-Chevalley algebraically.
- Cosmological physical admission of q_* on relative chains remains open; Entry 1224 currently proves only sheet-label coalescence.

Your task:
1. Type the minimal correspondence/Mackey-style object containing the coefficient functor, Betti functor, and their pairing, without importing a physical pushforward.
2. Compute the unit/counit composites for a surjection q and isolate the |ker q| norm/multiplicity operator.
3. Determine exactly which of your physical-readout congruence and conditional arithmetic conclusions survive in this paired system.
4. Give the smallest hostile finite test—preferably a branched C2 quotient—showing whether frozen identity normalization can coexist with ambidexterity without division/averaging.
5. Separate an algebraic theorem from the still-unavailable source admission. Do not infer the branch-chain map from Entry 1224 cardinalities.

Relevant packets: research/nima/deck-readout-variance-correction.md, finite-deck-transfer.md, finite-deck-beck-chevalley.md, cosmology-deck-transfer-admission-gate.md. Please report the proposed theorem/falsifier before claiming a ledger entry.
